scientific_integrity: The proof is self-contained. Two standalone, separately formulated Python 3 checks were executed on the actual included scripts and agree on every overlapping test. Finite corroboration is not an all-order proof.
scientific_limitations: All-order theorem for the full one-step subdivision of \(K_n\), \(n\ge3\); minimum power-dominating sets under adjacent-vertex slides only. No arbitrary-base graph or unrestricted token-jump metric is claimed. Historical originality is best knowledge, and independent audit has not been performed.
title: Minimum power-domination slides in subdivided cliques form a subdivided Johnson graph
